note: Recurring cost of living. Mostly flavour; paid monthly, normally through official channels (Credit Score), which is exactly how the system keeps people in debt. Prices are monthly, in Cr (Stables).

entries.name: Capsule Bunk
entries.desc: Rented sleeping pod in a corporate-managed tenement, paid by the night in company scrip. Shared washrooms, lockers extra.

entries.name: Tenement Room
entries.desc: One room in a rusted brick block under the dripping corporate tiers. Shared kitchen, unreliable heating.

entries.name: Standard Apartment
entries.desc: Two rooms in a Small Urban hub. Smart lock owned by the landlord's algorithm, rent auto-debited.

entries.name: Mid-Tier Flat
entries.desc: Climate-controlled unit above the awning line, with a doorman drone and a pristine AR overlay.

entries.name: Enclave Residence
entries.desc: Gated residence in a Pristine Enclave. Requires sponsorship and a flawless Credit Score.

entries.name: Ad-Supported Anchor Plan
entries.desc: Free data in exchange for unskippable ads and eye-tracking engagement billing. Amber Static DRM by default.

entries.name: Basic Data & Call Plan
entries.desc: Throttled data and voice on the Euro-Grid. Ads still play, but you can skip some of them.

entries.name: Standard Grid Plan
entries.desc: Unthrottled urban data, cloud backup and a reduced ad load on the Lens-Frame.

entries.name: Pristine Spectrum Plan
entries.desc: Full-colour, high-fidelity feeds. Reserved for compliant, high-credit profiles.

entries.name: Power Allocation
entries.desc: Metered Euro-Grid electricity. Throttled during demand spikes in low-priority sectors.

entries.name: Filtered Water Quota
entries.desc: Monthly allocation of potable water. Overage billed at the turnstile dispenser.

entries.name: Air Filtration Levy
entries.desc: Municipal surcharge for the block's air scrubbers. Non-payment is not an option in practice.

entries.name: Municipal Infrastructure Fee
entries.desc: Assessed without warning by the debt-paralyzed city administration. Amount varies.

entries.name: Company Bodega Rations
entries.desc: Synthetic, corporate-processed food bought with scrip at company-owned bodegas.

entries.name: Standard Groceries
entries.desc: Automated grocery deliveries from the Ledger. Mostly synthetic, occasionally real vegetables.

entries.name: Real-Food Subscription
entries.desc: Patented crops from the Rural Mono-Crop, delivered weekly. A status symbol.

entries.name: Worker Bus Pass
entries.desc: Subsidised seat on automated corporate buses. Lens-Frame must stay on for training modules during the ride.

entries.name: Autonomous Ride Credits
entries.desc: A monthly bundle of self-driving cab trips. Every trip logged.

entries.name: Vehicle Lease
entries.desc: Leased car with remote kill-switch held by the lender.

entries.name: Mandatory Medical Subscription
entries.desc: Baseline coverage required by law. Covers neural-dampeners for the Clinical Static, little else.

entries.name: Premium Medical Plan
entries.desc: Priority triage at corporate clinics and autodoc access.

entries.name: Neural-Dampener Prescription
entries.desc: Monthly supply of the pills that keep the Hum and the geometric night terrors quiet.

entries.name: Feed Stream Bundle
entries.desc: Ad-heavy streaming bundle, including live episodes of The Audit Room.

entries.name: Ad-Free Stream Bundle
entries.desc: The same feeds without the ads. Also unlocks voting on The Audit Room.

entries.name: Alg-Core Club Membership
entries.desc: Entry to a De-Sync club where the noise jams the audio surveillance grid.

entries.name: Lens-Frame Licence
entries.desc: Annual licence for your smart glasses, billed monthly. Unlicensed frames are bricked remotely.

entries.name: RFID Capsule Upkeep
entries.desc: Maintenance fee for the sub-skin identity capsule. Lapsing flags you as unregistered.

entries.name: Compliance Training Waiver
entries.desc: Pay to skip mandatory corporate training modules for a month.
